content: Nephropathy and retinopathy are significant complications observed in youth with Type 1 diabetes. The American Diabetes Association (ADA) emphasizes the importance of retinopathy management in this population. Retinal photography can serve as a valuable tool to enhance screening efforts for diabetic retinopathy. Programs that utilize retinal photography should prioritize ensuring timely referrals for comprehensive ophthalmologic examinations when abnormalities are detected or further evaluation is required.
